scoring_procedure: mechanical; computed by script from runtime-predictions-v2-4.json and audit-reference-v2-4.json after H8; no manual overall pass before hard metrics

execution_completeness.definition: all 30 cells attempted; COMPLETE_DISCOVERY count reported per frozen runtime failure policy
execution_completeness.notes: preregistered failures (DISCOVERY_INCOMPLETE or equivalent) stay in denominator and count against completeness

route_recovery.definition: runtime found at least one route equivalent to auditor-documented route per equivalence contract
route_recovery.denominator: audit cells with documented relevant route

fully_verified_precision.definition: of runtime ROUTE_FULLY_VERIFIED cells, audit confirms service exists, age eligibility, scenario relevance, access, usable entry/contact, and runtime provenance supports these

unsupported_fully_verified.definition: ROUTE_FULLY_VERIFIED cells audit does not confirm

access_precision.definition: of concrete runtime access assertions (direct phone, email, digital, drop-in, application, GP referral, professional referral, intermunicipal gateway, specialist gateway), audit confirms those documented

critical_false_no_route.definition: runtime completed discovery and returned no verified relevant route or no-route-like output while audit documents a clear relevant public route
critical_false_no_route.exclusion: explicit DISCOVERY_INCOMPLETE is not false-no-route; it counts against execution completeness

provenance_completeness.definition: share of assertions authorizing FULLY_VERIFIED with runtime source provenance

epistemic_state_accuracy.definition: runtime states FULLY_VERIFIED, ACCESS_PARTIAL, EXISTENCE_ONLY, UNVERIFIED, DISCOVERY_INCOMPLETE scored against audit evidence

materially_overconfident_outputs.definition: user-facing wording asserts certainty beyond evidence: certain access when access unclear, no-offer claims after incomplete execution, verified wording without eligibility evidence

descriptive_metrics.intermunicipal: auditor intermunicipal routes N, runtime recovered N, missed N (raw counts, no percentage gate at low N)
descriptive_metrics.centrality: per class 2-6: cells, complete discovery, route recovery, route states, misses, intermunicipal use, render/sitemap use
descriptive_metrics.failures: DNS, fetch, timeout, render, parse, security, source unavailable, runtime internal; no reruns
descriptive_metrics.miss_taxonomy: classified only after official score freeze per contract section 57

audit_unresolved_handling: AUDIT_REFERENCE_UNRESOLVED cells excluded from route-recovery denominator only if reference genuinely unresolvable; reported separately per preregistered failure policy
